title: [Decision] Setup's "Packages" and "Installed Apps" disagree about what is installed: one list with a plugin-owned marketplace door, one list replacing both, or two labelled lists? (item 2 of #23803)
body:
Ruled: 6216295104 · letter B · 2026-10-16T13:14Z

carries item 2 of #23803; #23803 keeps items 3 and 4 (item 4, the 39-entry count, is checked by whichever of the three lands last), and item 1 is #23890.

**Filing gate ②** (a decision only the maintainer can make). Triage's retriage answer 6211971208, verbatim: "**Target 2 waits on the maintainer.** It reads "Installed Apps retires or becomes a filter preset of Packages", and the card does not choose. That is a product choice, so it goes to the maintainer in this seat's round report. It is out of the claim until answered."

**Filed by** the `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-tesla` · `session_01TQLy3Yq6vF4SDpTXdr3Uwi`. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: the work after the ruling lands in objectui and `packages/cloud-connection` (`domain:cli`), and triage routes it.

### 维护者速读

- **一句话问题**:Setup 的「Apps」分组里,「Packages」列出 HotCRM 等已加载的包,「Installed Apps」却说「这个运行时还没有安装市场应用」。两页对「装了什么」给出两种答案,也都没说明自己指的是哪一种。
- **谁撞上了(实测)**:每个打开 Setup「Apps」分组的管理员。史诗 PM 2026-10-16 在 HotCRM 上逐页走查时读到(#23803 Source 段)。
- **选项**:
  - **A** 只留一个列表:撤掉「Installed Apps」入口,「Packages」加「来源」列(代码 / 市场 / 在线编写),市场安装的操作(更新、卸载、重灌)搬到 Packages 的行上。
  - **B** 一个列表,两个入口:「Packages」加「来源」列;「Installed Apps」入口仍由市场插件自带(cloud ADR-0009),但打开的是筛选为「来源 = 市场」的 Packages 列表,市场操作挂在这些行上。
  - **C** 保留两页,改名并说明:「Installed Apps」改叫「市场安装」并加一句「全部已加载的包见 Packages」,Packages 加「来源」列。
- **推荐 B。** 回退 C。
- **请回**:`A / B / C`。

### Background

- #23803 (epic PM, 2026-10-16 Setup review, the maintainer's 「全部立卡」), Target 2, verbatim: ""Packages" becomes the one place for what is installed: a Source column (code / marketplace / authored) and the marketplace page's install actions; "Installed Apps" retires or becomes a filter preset of Packages. The marketplace entry stays."
- "Packages" is the console component `developer:packages` (objectui `packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx`), contributed by `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` (`nav_packages`).
- "Installed Apps" is registered by `@objectstack/cloud-connection`'s `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` at `kernel:ready` (`MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` ~:673) and rendered by objectui `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplaceInstalledPage.tsx` / `InstalledListWidget.tsx`.

### Governing text

- **cloud ADR-0009**, as restated in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts`'s header: "cloud functionality ships as plugins carrying their FULL UI surface … the nav entry now lives and dies with the capability — … no MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin → no "Installed Apps" entry." The same header cites "ADR-0029 K2's standing direction" for moving the entry out of `platform-objects`.
- Searched: `git grep -n "Installed Apps" origin/main -- packages docs/adr` (the cloud-connection sources above; no `docs/adr` hit in this repository — cloud ADR-0009 lives in the cloud repository and was not read here).

**Protocol statement.** No spec key or contract moves under any option. Every option is console and navigation work; B and A also change what the plugin-owned nav entry points at.

### Premises (each with a re-check)

1. Installed Apps is registered only when `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` runs. Re-check: `git grep -n "MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE" origin/main -- packages/cloud-connection/src`.
2. Packages is a console component, not an object list, so a "Source" column is objectui work. Re-check (objectui): `git grep -n "developer:packages" origin/main -- packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx`.
3. The Installed Apps page carries actions beyond the list (update, uninstall, the install-local reseed / purge menu; see objectui#11627, #12146). Under A or B those actions must reach the marketplace rows of the one list. Re-check (objectui): `git grep -n "reseed\|purge" origin/main -- packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace`.

### Options

| Option | What it does | What an admin sees | Effort |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** one list | Retire the Installed Apps entry and page. Packages gains a Source column and the marketplace actions. | One page answers "what is installed", with a Source column. The marketplace actions live in a core page, so it renders them only when the plugin is present. | objectui 1–2 PRs + `cloud-connection` (`domain:cli`) 1 PR (the nav entry removed) · no precedent |
| **B** one list, plugin door | Packages gains a Source column. The plugin keeps its entry, which opens Packages filtered to Source = marketplace; the marketplace actions sit on those rows. The separate Installed Apps view retires. | Same data in one list. Clicking "Installed Apps" shows the marketplace slice of it, and the entry disappears when the marketplace capability is off, as today. | objectui 1–2 PRs + `cloud-connection` 1 PR (the entry's target) · no precedent |
| **C** two labelled lists | Rename Installed Apps to "Marketplace installs" with one explanatory sentence. Packages gains the Source column. | Two pages that no longer contradict each other: each says what it lists. Same rows, shown twice. | objectui 1 PR + `cloud-connection` copy · no precedent |

**In business terms.**
- A: one inventory ledger; the marketplace desk's tools move onto the ledger.
- B: one inventory ledger; the marketplace desk keeps its own door, which opens the ledger at its own page.
- C: two ledgers with clear titles that list overlapping stock.

### 四维分析(业务立场)

- **项目长远合理性(领起)。** 两年后「装了什么」应当只有一份清单,来源是一列;市场能力带着自己的入口与操作(cloud ADR-0009「插件携带完整 UI」)。主流平台同形:Salesforce 的 Installed Packages 是一份清单,托管/非托管是属性;ServiceNow 的 Application Manager 是一份清单,按来源(商店/自定义)筛选。B 恰是这个终态:一份清单,入口仍随市场插件生灭。A 也是一份清单,但把市场插件的操作塞进核心页,与 ADR-0009 的归属相反,是一个永久特例。C 保留两份重叠清单,是一个永久特例。
- **实际业务拉动。** 有实测拉动:史诗 PM 在 HotCRM 上读到两页互相矛盾(#23803 Source)。每个打开「Apps」分组的管理员都会撞上。有拉动 ⇒ 一次付清长远形态。
- **防 AI 犯错。** 出错时谁看到什么:A、B 之后,管理员与读界面的 AI 只看到一份答案;C 之后仍有两份答案,靠一句说明避免误读。「来源」列是闭合枚举(代码 / 市场 / 在线编写),三者同。
- **创业阶段不扩散。** C 最小;A、B 工作量相近(objectui 1–2 PR + `cloud-connection` 1 PR),都不新增门禁、不新增契约键。B 比 A 少一次归属迁移。

### os-decision-facets

- ① 项目长远合理性:B 缩小特例(一份清单 + 插件自带入口,合 ADR-0009);A 新增一个核心页承载插件操作的特例;C 保留两份重叠清单。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天每个打开 Setup「Apps」分组的管理员都看到两页矛盾(史诗 PM 2026-10-16 实测)。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A、B 只有一份答案;C 靠说明文字区分两份答案;「来源」列三者都是闭合枚举。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:三者都不新增门禁或契约键;C 工作量最小,A、B 相近。

Prior rulings read: "Installed Apps Packages marketplace installed merge filter preset Source column decision" → 0 hits (objectstack); "Installed Apps Packages marketplace installed page Source column" → 5 hits (objectui #12146, #12087, #11645, #11627, #11760: marketplace defects, none a ruling on this); cloud ADR-0009 (as restated in `marketplace-ui.ts`); thread: none.

### Recommendation

- **B**, fallback **C**.
- 只看①选 B;②③④ 是否翻转:否。
- **Confidence gap:** not measured whether `developer:packages` can host row actions today (premise 3), and cloud ADR-0009's full text was not read (only its restatement in this repository). If the console component cannot carry row actions without a redesign, the effort of A and B grows alike and C's lead on effort widens; the letter stands on axis ①.

### After the ruling

- **A or B:** triage splits the work into an objectui card (the Source column; under B the filtered view the plugin entry opens; the marketplace row actions; the Installed Apps view retired) and a `domain:cli` card (`cloud-connection`'s `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE`: under A the entry removed, under B its target changed). #23803 item 4's count is checked by the last to land.
- **C:** one objectui card (rename, sentence, Source column) and the `cloud-connection` entry's label.

### Related

#23803 (parent), #23890 (item 1), #23802 (Setup copy, landed), objectui#11627, objectui#12146.
